correctness.rationale: Enumerating all 2^16 vertex subsets identifies 321 independent faces including the empty simplex, 80 4-facets and a complete explicit 80-facet shelling order (3160 prior-facet comparisons in inspected certificate). Shelling implies X and links of all faces are wedges of spheres in top degree with torsion-free integral homology; the Euler characteristic gives exactly one S3. Independently implemented combinatorial orbit and bitset mod-2 boundary-rank computations on all 321 faces confirm 17 dihedral face orbits and top-link rank 2 on vertices, edge distance 2/5/7 and one 32-triangle orbit, rank 1 elsewhere. Original checker also verifies mod3; shellability supplies integral torsion freeness, not inference from two primes alone. Rank-two triangles have 16 vertices,48 edges,32 triangles, each edge in two triangles, each vertex link a connected six-cycle; explicit oriented 32-triangle chain has zero integer boundary and chi=0, giving a connected orientable torus. The local-homology shift matches top H3.
